_comment: Edit this list, put the zips under <files>/addons and <files>/packs, then run: node tools/make-catalogs.mjs --files <dir> --base-url http://10.2.5.65/launcher. Entries whose zip is missing are skipped with a warning. Addons must be on client-config/approved-addons.json. The map, XI View and TargetLines zips are built from their GitHub repositories by goomba-xi-server/tools/community-packs.sh, which also fills in their versions.

addons.name: XIUI
addons.author: Tirem
addons.description: Modern party list, target bar, player bar and cast bar.

addons.name: LuAshitacast
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: Lua-based automatic gear swapping, like GearSwap for Ashita.

addons.name: MobDB
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: On-screen monster info: a target's drops, stealable items, spawn points and stats. Imports the server's own data.

addons.name: tHotBar
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: On-screen hotbars for abilities, spells and items.

addons.name: tCrossBar
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: Controller-friendly crossbar, great on the Steam Deck.

addons.name: statustimers
addons.author: Heals
addons.description: Timers for buffs and debuffs on you and your target.

addons.name: TargetLines
addons.author: jyouya
addons.description: Draws Final Fantasy XII style target lines during combat.

packs.name: Combined Maps: Basic
packs.description: All of the game's maps in one pack (1024x1024): labeled originals, Remapster and Moops' labeled Remapster maps, layered. Maps by RadialArcana, the FFXI Remapster Project and Moophorizon; combined by CriticalXI.
packs.author: CriticalXI (combined), RadialArcana, FFXI Remapster Project, Moophorizon

packs.name: Combined Maps: HD
packs.description: The same combined maps in high resolution (2048x2048). Larger download; pick this or Basic.
packs.author: CriticalXI (combined), RadialArcana, FFXI Remapster Project, Moophorizon

packs.name: XI View: Standard
packs.description: Cleaner menus, fonts, status and menu icons, standard (4:3) layout.
packs.author: KenshiDRK

packs.name: XI View: Widescreen
packs.description: Cleaner menus, fonts, status and menu icons, laid out for 16:9 and 16:10 screens.
packs.author: KenshiDRK
